GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   C. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

10. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   D. Treat Climate as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

13. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

14. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

15. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weathering as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
